environment_notes: PostgreSQL 19 beta4 / pg_search 0.26.1 source-built with repository compatibility patch in a cached SDK image (cb67405b38115285c20566b9eadede61b1521e5cc8f793bd35daf6e7dcdb2d77); experimental, not an official upstream PG19 package or a new full Docker build.
Shared macOS host with other workloads; vm.swapusage used 28247.94M before validation. Absolute timings and observed speedups are exploratory.

pg_pinyin candidate installed with cargo pgrx install --release; current full regex bodies are unchanged from rebased reference c33bb89. Earlier P0/P1/P2 reports use different protocols and are not directly comparable.
The 2000 timed dictionary-derived queries contain multiple syllables; single-syllable score/rank differences are covered separately by handwritten gold, not represented in timed performance averages.
